verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents signed, real-time webhook notifications covering registrations, renewals, transfers, upcoming expirations and DNS changes as a replacement for polling. Deliveries are verified with an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the timestamp and raw body, and sandbox keys also deliver signed webhooks for testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how endpoints are registered and event types subscribed, delivery/retry semantics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get signed, real-time notifications (registrations, renewals, transfers, upcoming expirations, DNS changes) instead of polling — and prove each delivery really came from Porkbun.
The signature is HMAC-SHA256(secret, "{timestamp}.{rawBody}") over the raw request body
